_doc: External reference energies per (frame, dim, n_b, L, A) for classical/trimci/external_bounds.py. kind=variational_upper: a variational energy from another method on the SAME truncated Hamiltonian (frame, n_b, N_f) -- an extrapolated limit above it is refuted. kind=exact: the untruncated ground-state energy -- a truncated limit below it is refuted, and the deviation is the calibration. Cross-frame bounds never enter the gate (different operator). Energies in MeV, Wick contact convention.

entries.method: exact A=0 pion vacuum, multimode Bogoliubov (analytic_bogoliubov), untruncated
entries.source: PROJECT_CONTEXT.md live state (2026-10-09); per-site value quoted to 3 decimals
entries.note: A=0 has no contact term, so convention-free; the untruncated answer is a LOWER bound on every truncated (any n_b, any frame) limit, and the reference every A=0 extrapolation is compared against; E_ps is quoted to 3 decimals, so it carries a +-0.0005/site rounding precision (E_ps_precision) that gate 5 adds to sigma
